title: Twins Do Not Share Fingerprints
hook: Identical twins do not have identical fingerprints.
script: Identical twins do not have identical fingerprints. Police have never found two people whose prints match. So the code they share is not the whole story. So what actually decides them? They form in the womb, shaped by tiny details like pressure and the flow of fluid around your fingers. Every baby meets its own pressure and its own fluid flow, even next to a twin. Is the mark police trust most really just chance? Yes. It is mostly randomness, because fingerprints are not in your genes.
